AsymmetricDecrypt.title: AsymmetricDecrypt
AsymmetricDecrypt.summary: Decrypts data by using the private key of an asymmetric CMK.

AsymmetricEncrypt.title: AsymmetricEncrypt
AsymmetricEncrypt.summary: Encrypts data by using the public key of an asymmetric CMK.

AsymmetricSign.title: AsymmetricSign
AsymmetricSign.summary: Generates a digital signature by using an asymmetric CMK.

AsymmetricVerify.title: AsymmetricVerify
AsymmetricVerify.summary: Verifies a digital signature by using the public key of an asymmetric CMK.

CancelKeyDeletion.title: CancelKeyDeletion
CancelKeyDeletion.summary: Cancels the deletion task of a CMK.

ConnectKmsInstance.title: ConnectKmsInstance
ConnectKmsInstance.summary: Enables a Key Management Service (KMS) instance.

CreateAlias.title: CreateAlias
CreateAlias.summary: Creates an alias for a key.

CreateKey.title: CreateKey
CreateKey.summary: Creates a customer master key (CMK) for envelope encryption, digital signatures, or other cryptographic operations.

CreateKeyVersion.title: CreateKeyVersion
CreateKeyVersion.summary: Creates a version for a customer master key (CMK).

CreateNetworkRule.title: CreateNetworkRule
CreateNetworkRule.summary: Creates a network access rule to configure the private IP addresses or private CIDR blocks that are allowed to access a Key Management Service (KMS) instance.

CreatePolicy.title: CreatePolicy
CreatePolicy.summary: Creates a permission policy to configure the keys and secrets that are allowed to access.

CreateSecret.title: CreateSecret
CreateSecret.summary: Creates a secret and stores its initial version.

Decrypt.title: Decrypt
Decrypt.summary: Decrypts ciphertext that was encrypted by using a CMK.

DeleteKeyMaterial.title: DeleteKeyMaterial
DeleteKeyMaterial.summary: Deletes the imported key material from a CMK. After deletion, the CMK enters the PendingImport state until you re-import key material.

DescribeAccountKmsStatus.title: DescribeAccountKmsStatus
DescribeAccountKmsStatus.summary: Queries the status of Key Management Service (KMS) within your Alibaba Cloud account.

DescribeApplicationAccessPoint.title: DescribeApplicationAccessPoint
DescribeApplicationAccessPoint.summary: Retrieves the details of an application access point (AAP).

DescribeKey.title: DescribeKey
DescribeKey.summary: Queries the metadata of a CMK, such as the key state, usage, and rotation configuration.

DescribeKeyVersion.title: DescribeKeyVersion
DescribeKeyVersion.summary: Queries the metadata of a specific CMK version.

DescribeNetworkRule.title: DescribeNetworkRule
DescribeNetworkRule.summary: Retrieves the details of a network access rule.

DescribePolicy.title: DescribePolicy
DescribePolicy.summary: Retrieves the details of a permission policy.

DescribeRegions.title: DescribeRegions
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions where KMS is available.

DescribeSecret.title: DescribeSecret
DescribeSecret.summary: Queries the metadata of a secret.

EnableKey.title: EnableKey
EnableKey.summary: Enables a key to encrypt and decrypt data.

Encrypt.title: Encrypt
Encrypt.summary: Encrypts plaintext by using a symmetric CMK.

ExportDataKey.title: ExportDataKey
ExportDataKey.summary: Exports a data key encrypted by a CMK. The data key is re-encrypted by a public key that you specify for secure transmission.

GenerateAndExportDataKey.title: GenerateAndExportDataKey
GenerateAndExportDataKey.summary: Generates a random data key, encrypts it by using a CMK and a public key that you specify, and returns both ciphertexts.

GenerateDataKey.title: GenerateDataKey
GenerateDataKey.summary: Generates a random data key for envelope encryption. The data key is returned in both plaintext and ciphertext forms.

GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext.title: GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext.summary: Generates a random data key in only ciphertext form, without the plaintext copy.

GenerateMac.title: Generate HMAC message authentication code
GenerateMac.summary: Generates an HMAC message authentication code for a message by using a specified key.

GetClientKey.title: GetClientKey
GetClientKey.summary: Retrieves information about a client key.

GetDefaultKmsInstance.title: GetDefaultKmsInstance
GetDefaultKmsInstance.summary: Queries the default KMS instance in a specified region.

GetKeyPolicy.title: GetKeyPolicy
GetKeyPolicy.summary: Queries the key policy of a CMK in a KMS instance.

GetKmsInstance.title: GetKmsInstance
GetKmsInstance.summary: Retrieves the details of a KMS instance.

GetKmsInstanceQuotaInfos.title: GetKmsInstanceQuotaInfos
GetKmsInstanceQuotaInfos.summary: Queries the quota usage and limits for a KMS instance.

GetManagedDataKey.title: Retrieve managed data key plaintext
GetManagedDataKey.summary: Retrieves the plaintext of a managed data key (DK).

GetParametersForImport.title: GetParametersForImport
GetParametersForImport.summary: Queries the parameters that are used to import key material for a customer master key (CMK).

GetPublicKey.title: GetPublicKey
GetPublicKey.summary: Retrieves the public key of an asymmetric key. You can use the public key to encrypt data or verify a signature on your device.

GetSecretPolicy.title: GetSecretPolicy
GetSecretPolicy.summary: Queries the access policy of a specified secret in a KMS instance.

ImportKeyMaterial.title: ImportKeyMaterial
ImportKeyMaterial.summary: Imports externally generated key material into a CMK whose origin is EXTERNAL.

ListAliases.title: ListAliases
ListAliases.summary: Queries all aliases in the current region for the current account.

ListAliasesByKeyId.title: ListAliasesByKeyId
ListAliasesByKeyId.summary: Queries all aliases that are bound to a key.

ListApplicationAccessPoints.title: ListApplicationAccessPoints
ListApplicationAccessPoints.summary: Queries all application access points (AAPs) in the current region.

ListClientKeys.title: ListClientKeys
ListClientKeys.summary: Queries all client keys within an AAP.

ListKeyVersions.title: ListKeyVersions
ListKeyVersions.summary: Queries all versions of a specified CMK.

ListKeys.title: ListKeys
ListKeys.summary: Queries the IDs and ARNs of all CMKs in the current region.

ListKmsInstances.title: ListKmsInstances
ListKmsInstances.summary: Queries all KMS instances in the current region.

ListManagedDataKeyVersions.title: List key versions of a managed data key
ListManagedDataKeyVersions.summary: Lists the key versions of a specified managed data key (DK).

ListNetworkRules.title: ListNetworkRules
ListNetworkRules.summary: Queries all network access rules in the current region.

ListPolicies.title: ListPolicies
ListPolicies.summary: Queries all permission policies in the current region.

ListResourceTags.title: ListResourceTags
ListResourceTags.summary: Queries the tags of a customer master key (CMK).

ListSecretVersionIds.title: Query all version information of a secret
ListSecretVersionIds.summary: Queries all version information of a secret.

ListSecrets.title: ListSecrets
ListSecrets.summary: Queries all secrets in the current region.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Lists the tags that are bound to a key or a secret.

OpenKmsService.title: OpenKmsService
OpenKmsService.summary: Activates Key Management Service (KMS) for your Alibaba Cloud account.

PutSecretValue.title: PutSecretValue
PutSecretValue.summary: Stores a new version of a secret value for a generic secret.

ReEncrypt.title: ReEncrypt
ReEncrypt.summary: Re-encrypts ciphertext under a different CMK without exposing the plaintext.

ScheduleKeyDeletion.title: ScheduleKeyDeletion
ScheduleKeyDeletion.summary: Deletes a specified customer master key (CMK).

SetDeletionProtection.title: Set deletion protection
SetDeletionProtection.summary: Enables or disables deletion protection for a customer master key (CMK).

SetKeyPolicy.title: SetKeyPolicy
SetKeyPolicy.summary: Sets the key policy for a CMK in a KMS instance.

SetSecretPolicy.title: SetSecretPolicy
SetSecretPolicy.summary: Sets the access policy for a secret in a KMS instance.

TagResource.title: TagResource
TagResource.summary: Adds tags to a CMK, secret, or certificate.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Adds tags to one or more keys or secrets.

UntagResource.title: UntagResource
UntagResource.summary: Removes tags from a CMK, secret, or certificate.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Removes tags from keys or secrets.

UpdateAlias.title: UpdateAlias
UpdateAlias.summary: Binds an existing alias to a different customer master key (CMK) ID.

UpdateApplicationAccessPoint.title: UpdateApplicationAccessPoint
UpdateApplicationAccessPoint.summary: Updates the information about an application access point (AAP).

UpdateKeyDescription.title: UpdateKeyDescription
UpdateKeyDescription.summary: Updates the description of a CMK.

UpdateKmsInstanceBindVpc.title: UpdateKmsInstanceBindVpc
UpdateKmsInstanceBindVpc.summary: Updates the VPC bindings of a KMS instance.

UpdateRotationPolicy.title: UpdateRotationPolicy
UpdateRotationPolicy.summary: Updates the automatic rotation policy of a CMK.

UpdateSecret.title: UpdateSecret
UpdateSecret.summary: Updates the metadata of a secret.

UpdateSecretRotationPolicy.summary: Updates the rotation policy of a secret.

UpdateSecretVersionStage.summary: Moves a version stage label to a different version of a secret.
